# Enhanced Virgin Fund Trading Platform Overview

## Project Overview
Build a polished, production-ready social trading bot platform-as-a-service (PaaS) called Virgin Fund, integrated with Alpaca Markets for stock and crypto trading. The platform enables users to create, backtest, and deploy automated trading bots with advanced features like AI-assisted strategies, copy-trading, leaderboards, and real-time analytics. Emphasize security, scalability, and user experience with a focus on accessibility and performance.

## Success Criteria
- Users can sign up, create bots, backtest strategies, go live safely, and engage socially.
- Platform handles 1000+ concurrent users with <2s response times.
